notes.title: [Friday Update] Last Weekly Demo Update
notes.notes:
Today is the last weekly update of Arboreal. Thanks to those who followed the development during the last months, look at how far we have come! 
This week on top of some stabilization, you will find a whole new tutorial.
After a few weeks of rest, Arboreal will be back in an even more advanced version aiming before the end of 2021. 

Today is also the last day of Tiiy as a member of the team, thanks a lot for his help!

And to celebrate in style the last update, here is a new trailer of Arboreal.

[previewyoutube=gHbRVs72LqY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope you'll enjoy and see you in a few months.

notes.notes:

notes.title: [Friday update] Good vibes energy
notes.notes:
New update for Friday the 13th, with some refreshing changes to many aspects of the game. 


New engine, no need to link every machine to it anymore, now energy is automatically propagated through upper branches
Revamped press machine
New mushroom sponge, giving upper branches an irrigation bonus
New flux visualizer: mechanical energy propagated through the tree
More feedback for each tool
And as always some graphical improvements and bug fixing

notes.title: [Friday Update] Knock on Wood
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318421/4f9a44234f2f86ade09e60426676386ef673f154.gif

Big changes are in the works, you may find some fresh paint marks here and there in this weekly update, Arboreal might be a bit less stable than usual. But fear not, it will be back to normal next week!

For this update v.0.7.3 (third week of July), you'll play with:

Branch collisions! The time of losing your fruits in the deep void is coming to an end... make circumvoluted tracks way more easily
Liked the introducing of the spirit of the forest last week? Meet its three evolutions: tiny, strong and ultimate
Gameplay tweaks: branches dry faster, make them too long and they will break faster, but on the plus side branch can repair naturally if you improve their balance
Some changes for the bee residents, but expect more to come in the upcoming update

notes.title: [Friday Update] New Demo Every Friday, here comes the first update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

After the big reveal of Arboreal during the Steam Next Fest last week, we're going to keep the momentum going this summer with the ambitious goal of updating the demo every Friday.

That's right: each week you will be able to try out freely new features and gameplay possibilities while they're being made.

There is still a long way to go to complete Arboreal as we desire, but piece by piece it's getting somewhere.

So here is what you can expect in this update v.0.6.4 for the last week of June: 

- New structure available in game: a fruit-juice-powered Engine, to automatize machinery 
- New bark visuals
- Bugs fixing
- UX: You can catch fruits more easily 
- UX: Free rotation of flowers and mushroom 

Thank you to the thousands of players who downloaded the demo, we hope you'll continue to enjoy the game and see you next week!!!
